# A Complete Guide to Buy Now, Pay Later


October 26, 2026


*How do you use Pay in 4 (or Pay in 5)?*


Sezzle is a buy now, pay later (BNPL) platform that lets shoppers split a purchase into smaller payments instead of paying in full upfront.


With Sezzle's most popular plans—Pay in 4* and Pay in 5†—customers make a smaller payment at checkout, then pay the rest in equal installments every two weeks. Pay in 4 splits a purchase into four payments over six weeks, starting with 25% down. Pay in 5 spreads it further, starting with 20% down and finishing over eight weeks. As everyday costs rise, tools like Sezzle have become a common way to manage cash flow without revolving debt.


## **How Sezzle's Payment Plans Work**


Beyond the Pay in 4 you’ve probably heard of, Sezzle offers other installment structures: Pay in 5 (20% down, then four more biweekly payments) and Pay Monthly¶, a longer-term option for larger purchases. Which plan a shopper sees, and how much they're approved for, comes from a proprietary review Sezzle runs at checkout rather than a fixed credit line.


Once an order is placed, Sezzle pays the merchant in full immediately. That's part of what makes Sezzle attractive to retailers: they're paid up front and see fewer abandoned carts, while the customer takes on the installment schedule instead.


## **Approval, Spending Power, and Credit Checks**


Sezzle's estimated spending power‖ isn't static. At each checkout, factors like payment history, account tenure, and order size are reviewed to determine which plans and estimated spending power are available. Most orders involve a soft credit check only, which doesn't affect a shopper's credit score.


## **Who Can Use Sezzle?**


Sezzle is designed to be usable across the credit spectrum, not just for shoppers who already have strong credit. Because approval is based on factors like payment history and order size rather than a traditional credit line, someone with little or no credit history may still be approved for a purchase. Most orders only involve a soft credit check**, so applying doesn't affect a shopper's credit score the way a hard inquiry would.


## **How Sezzle Encourages Responsible Spending**


Sezzle also builds spending guardrails directly into the product. If a shopper has a failed or missed payment on an existing order, they can't place a new order until that payment is paid off and fully processed, so an account can't be used to take on more installment debt while a previous payment is still unresolved. It's a built-in check against the kind of overlapping payments that make BNPL hard to manage, functioning almost like training wheels for credit: a way to build responsible payment habits before taking on a product like a credit card.


## **Building Credit with Sezzle Up**


Shoppers who want Sezzle activity to count toward their credit history can enroll in Sezzle Up††, which reports eligible biweekly payment activity monthly to Equifax, TransUnion, Experian, and Innovis. On-time payments are reported as current, and payments more than 30 days late are reported as delinquent.


## **Using Sezzle Beyond Partner Checkouts**


Not every retailer offers Sezzle directly at checkout. For those cases, Sezzle Anywhere is a subscription add-on that unlocks a multi-use virtual card, usable through digital wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay both online and in-store, anywhere Visa is accepted. The card is issued by WebBank, and purchases made with it can still be split using Sezzle's standard plans.


## **Key Takeaways**


Sezzle's Pay in 4* or Pay in 5† plan splits a purchase into four or five payments: 20-25% due at checkout, then three or four payments every two weeks over six or eight weeks. Pay in 5 is 0% APR with a paid subscription.


Sezzle earns revenue through merchant processing fees, service fees on certain Pay in 4 and Pay in 5 orders *(* which vary by order amount), and subscription products like Sezzle Anywhere‡.


Approval and estimated spending power‖ are based on factors like payment history and order size rather than a fixed credit line, and most orders only involve a soft credit check** that doesn't affect a shopper's credit score.


Sezzle is built to be usable across the credit spectrum, and it blocks new purchases if a shopper has a failed payment on a previous order, helping prevent overlapping, hard-to-manage debt.


Sezzle Up†† is an optional program that reports eligible payment activity to major credit bureaus, so Sezzle payments can count toward a shopper's credit history.


Sezzle Anywhere‡ is a subscription add-on that unlocks a virtual Sezzle card§ usable anywhere Visa is accepted, extending Sezzle beyond partner-merchant checkouts. It's the most popular of Sezzle's subscription products. A Premium tier is also available with in-app discounts, priority support, and rewards.


## **FAQs**


**How does Sezzle work?** Sezzle lets shoppers split a purchase into installments, most commonly four payments over six weeks, with 25% due at checkout.


**Does Sezzle charge interest?** It depends on the plan. Pay in 5† is 0% APR with a paid subscription.Some Pay in 4* and Pay in 5 *†* orders include a service fee at checkout *,* which varies by order amount and carries an APR (see disclosures below). Fees may also apply if a payment is missed.


**Does Sezzle do a hard credit check?** No. Most Sezzle orders only involve a soft credit check**, which doesn't affect a shopper's credit score.


**Can Sezzle help build credit history?** Yes, through Sezzle Up††. Enrolled shoppers have eligible payment activity, including late payments, reported monthly to major credit bureaus.


**Can I use Sezzle anywhere?** At partner retailers, yes, directly at checkout. Sezzle Anywhere‡ subscribers get a virtual card§ usable anywhere Visa is accepted.


**What happens if I miss a payment?** New purchases are blocked until the missed payment is resolved and fully processed. You may be charged a failed payment or late fee depending on the specifics of your order and when the payment is corrected. Sezzle Anywhere‡ subscribers get one added protection: the option to reschedule a payment‡‡ for free before it's missed.

## **Disclaimers**


*Pay in 4: Issued by WebBank or Sezzle. See loan agreement for details. For example, for a $300 loan, $75 down payment + $7.49 service fee today, then 3 payments of $75 every 2 weeks. 45.0% APR. Service fees vary by loan amount. Paid subscription may be required.


†Pay in 5: Issued by WebBank. See loan agreement for details. 20% down, 4 payments of 20% every 2 weeks, 0% APR with paid subscription.


‡Sezzle Anywhere can only be used for US purchases where Visa is accepted. Certain merchant, product, goods, and service restrictions apply.


§Sezzle Virtual Cards are issued by WebBank, Member FDIC, pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A Inc. See User Agreement for details. Sezzle provides access to financing in the form of installment loans. Sezzle is not a bank.


‖Estimated Spending Power is a point in time estimate of how much you may be able to spend and is subject to credit approval.


¶Pay Monthly loans are originated by third party lenders, including WebBank. Refer to your loan agreement for details. APR ranges from 0.00%–35.99% based on creditworthiness and term length, subject to credit approval. For example, a $1,000 loan over 6 months would result in 6 monthly payments of $166.67 at 0.00% APR, $178.90 at 24.99% APR, or $184.29 at 35.99% APR. Minimum purchase amount may be required.


**New customers may have a credit check when they first sign up to use the platform. This credit check will not impact a customer's credit score.


††Opt-in to voluntary credit reporting by enrolling in Sezzle Up. Increases or specific changes to your credit score are not guaranteed. Impact on your credit score may vary depending on your use. All payments, including late payments, are required to be reported, which may negatively impact your credit score. Credit scores are independently determined by credit bureaus based on a number of factors, including the financial decisions you make with other financial services organizations. The program and related services will not remove negative credit history from your credit report.


‡‡A fee may be incurred for rescheduling payments. Please refer to Account Disclosures.
